The league began on March 11 and ended on November 26. At the end of the season, the second stage winner [[Kashima Antlers]] won the [[J.League Championship|Suntory Championship]] against [[Yokohama F. Marinos]] who won the first stage. ==Clubs== The following 16 clubs participated in Division 1 during 2000 season. Of these clubs, Kawasaki Frontale and FC Tokyo were promoted from Division 2. * [[Avispa Fukuoka]] * [[Cerezo Osaka]] * [[FC Tokyo]] [[Image:Arrowupgreen.png]] * [[Gamba Osaka]] * [[JEF United Chiba|JEF United Ichihara]] * [[Júbilo Iwata]] * [[Kashima Antlers]] * [[Kashiwa Reysol]] * [[Kawasaki Frontale]] [[Image:Arrowupgreen.png]] * [[Kyoto Sanga FC|Kyoto Purple Sanga]] * [[Nagoya Grampus|Nagoya Grampus Eight]] * [[Sanfrecce Hiroshima]] * [[Shimizu S-Pulse]] * [[Tokyo Verdy|Verdy Kawasaki]] * [[Vissel Kobe]] * [[Yokohama F.
